name: So huyet
summary: Sò huyết is a blood cockle, cooked from the live shell, including the town plate sò huyết la cót.
howToEat: Cooked to order, at lunch or dinner.
380,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking.
where: The town streets, or chợ hải sản Hàng Dương.
seoTitle: So huyet — blood cockles in Can Gio
seoDescription: Sò huyết is a blood cockle cooked from the live shell, including sò huyết la cót.
